parsed.use_case: A weather service can compute, for every forecast day, how long until the next warmer day, helping users spot upcoming warm-ups without repeatedly scanning the forecast.
system_examples: Weather forecasting services — derive the wait to the next warmer forecast day for each date in a forecast window.
Time-series alerting systems — determine the next timestamp at which a monitored temperature series exceeds each recorded value.
parsed.explanation: A monotonic stack processes the temperatures in O(n) time and O(n) space, instead of the naive O(n²) repeated forward scans. This matters when the same next-greater lookup is applied to long streams or many time series; the specific daily-weather output is also a useful teaching exercise.
